# Cafe Moss

Small cafe near the river embankment. Good mushroom soup and rye toast; they can make dishes without coriander on request.

## Visits

- Breakfast with Ilsa, rated 4 of 5: slow service but great soup.
- Lunch alone, rated 5 of 5: quiet table by the window.
